_comment: DRAFT (Epic 9, Stories 9.1-9.5): the travelling Bard in the hall (scripts/game/bard.gd; his body scripts/npcs/bard_npc.gd). When he comes is game_config.json's bard_* keys (GameManager.bard_visit). bard.body: the townsfolk variant id his body comes from (data/characters/townsfolk.json): a PLACEHOLDER, the merchant (his feathered beret reads as a minstrel), until Story 25.12's Bard replaces it here; while he is in the hall no new patron wears that body. speaker: his id in data/dialogue/speakers.json. dialogue: his conversation (data/dialogue/bard.dialogue: door_first, door_N, song_N). porch [x, y, z]: where he appears, outside the front door (the staff's porch point); route_in: the points he walks first (inside the door), then the wait spot. wait_spot / perform_spot [x, z, yaw_deg]: MainTavern coordinates, measured (Story 9.1 T1: on the navmesh, 2.3 m from every other E zone, 4.55 m from every patron seat for the wait spot, off the staff's routes; Test 39); a node in group bard_perform_point (Story 25.12's corner) wins over perform_spot. walk_in_timeout_seconds: not inside by then, he is placed at the last route point. perform_clip: the clip he plays while performing (a PLACEHOLDER until Story 25.16's lute clip). lute: a PLACEHOLDER lute built from primitives (Story 25.12's H9 replaces it): carry (on his back while he walks and waits) and play (in his hands while he performs): bone, offset [x, y, z] metres in the bone's frame, rotation_deg [x, y, z]; scale. indicator: the sign over his head while he plays ('' = none). music_path: his music ('' = the code-made placeholder phrase, scripts/audio/placeholder_lute.gd); music_volume_db on the Music bus. text: the prompts and banners (banner_allowed says what he keeps; day_end and payment_suffix fill {share}). leave_lines: what he says as he moves on unheard; closing_lines: his last line at closing time (Story 9.2). rumours (Story 9.2): what his songs leave in Latest News after a performance; {place} a factions.json biome, {faction} a rival guild, {capital} a capitals.json capital (MOD-7); each line names at least one. Every line is DRAFT: Raphael rewrites.

text.prompt_door: Press E - Talk to the Bard
text.prompt_play: Press E - Listen to the Bard
text.banner_arrival: A travelling bard is waiting at the door.
text.banner_timeout: The Bard got tired of waiting and moved on.
text.banner_allowed: The Bard plays for the room. He keeps a share of the tips.
text.day_end: The Bard kept {share} gold of the day's tips.

leave_lines: No one at the door. The road it is.
Suit yourself, keeper. The song keeps.
closing_lines: That's the last song. Good night, keeper.
The fire's low and so am I. Good night.
Same time on the road, keeper.
rumours: The Bard sang of {place}, where the old road floods each spring and nobody rebuilds it.
The Bard sang of the {faction}: three went out, two came back, and nobody sings the third.
The Bard sang of {capital}, where the bells ring for a king nobody has seen.
The Bard sang of lights under {place}, the kind that move when you look away.
The Bard sang of the {faction} buying maps of {place}. Nobody knows what they're looking for.
The Bard sang of a shrine in {place} where the offerings are never touched, and never there in the morning.
